description: Source code for a simple x86 disassembler class (DisassemblerX86) that provides instruction disassembly, flags instructions based on known bad register values, and manages internal state related to disassembly process.

classes.name: DisassemblerX86
classes.description: A class that performs disassembly of x86 bytecode, flags instructions based on bad register values, and maintains disassembly state.

methods.name: NextInstruction
methods.description: Disassembles the next instruction, updates internal state, and flags instructions involving bad registers.

methods.name: setBadRead
methods.description: Marks the current instruction's source operand as a bad register read.

methods.name: setBadWrite
methods.description: Marks the current instruction's destination operand as a bad register write.
